Dating is the most exciting yet confusing time in a single girl's life... and being overweight just makes it that much more complicated. You never know who you are going to meet, where the night could take you, or what the future may or may not hold. From hook ups to heartbreak there is never a dull moment and it's hard on a girl's emotions. But for girls who are overweight, it's a wild emotional rollercoaster ride... and they are just praying the seat belt fits. This series will follow 5 parallel stories of plus size single women in 5 different cities across the country. We'll see the ups and downs of their dating endeavors and see just how different it is in various parts of the country. We'll soon find out that these women may have being overweight in common, but they certainly don't all have the same approach to finding love.
